rationale: The plan targets exactly the right inference: a DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time, with time as a 4-level factor justified by the saturated 2x4x3 layout and 16 residual df, plus a limma-voom moderated F-test on the same three interaction coefficients as a concordance check and a secondary continuous-time model to separate monotonic from transient divergence. QC is concrete and design-aware (column-to-metadata matching with the 25-vs-24 discrepancy resolved explicitly, condition x time cross-tabulation for n=3 per cell, VST PCA colored by condition and shaped by time, distance heatmap, library sizes, size factors, named outliers), the filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, the smallest group size) is minimal and justified, and normalization stays inside the model with raw integer counts. Contrasts, reference levels, reduced model, BH at stated alpha with a 0.05/0.10 policy, and apeglm/ashr shrinkage for reported effects are all explicit, and the t0 contrast as a baseline-imbalance control is a genuine design insight. Enrichment is not strictly warranted here but is handled carefully with the expression-filtered background, named human collections with versions, and a stated signed ranking; it loses points only for omitting a gene-set size window. Reporting is thorough on design, thresholds, gene counts and caveats, though software versions are only requested for gene-set collections rather than for the analysis packages.
